label: GB-equality-act-2010 Schedule 11

obligations.text:
(7)
An application under sub-paragraph (6) must specify—
(a)
the period proposed by the responsible body as the transitional period to be specified in the order,
(b)
the stages within that period by which the body proposes to move to the position where section 85(1)(a) and (c), so far as relating to sex, is complied with, and
(c)
any other matters relevant to the terms and operation of the order applied for.

(8)
The Commission must not make an order on an application under sub-paragraph (6) unless satisfied that the terms of the application are reasonable, having regard to—
(a)
the nature of the school's premises,
(b)
the accommodation, equipment and facilities available, and
(c)
the responsible body's financial resources.

(3)
Before making an order under this paragraph the Minister must consult—
(a)
the Welsh Ministers,
(b)
the Scottish Ministers, and
(c)
such other persons as the Minister thinks appropriate.
